entry.title: A fixture identity for alternating sign matrices under a synthetic weight
entry.summary: This project-authored fixture abstract describes an invented weight on alternating sign matrices and states a synthetic identity. It exists to exercise the corpus ingestion path and asserts nothing about mathematics.

entry.title: Synthetic bounds for a fictional exponential sum
entry.summary: A project-authored fixture abstract. It names a fictional exponential sum and a synthetic bound so that the parser, the record builder and the fair-quotation projection have text to operate on. No claim here is a mathematical claim.

entry.title: Spectral extent of a project-authored distance matrix family
entry.summary: A fixture abstract long enough to be truncated by the pinned fair-quotation bound, so that the projection's truncation flag is exercised rather than asserted. It discusses an invented family of symmetric integer distance matrices, states a synthetic bound on the number of distinct eigenvalues, and deliberately continues past two hundred and forty characters so the reader-facing quotation must be cut and the record must still link out to its abstract page.
